The following events took place in '''4008 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Deaths==
*[[Jev Sunrider]] on [[Krayiss II]]<ref>Andur Sunrider leaves [[H'ratth]] for [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] per [[Tales of the Jedi 3|''Tales of the Jedi'' 3]]. The ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' says that 2 years prior (4002 BBY), Andur went to H'ratth, and six years prior to that (4008 BBY), he saw the Force ghost of his grandfather Jev, who the Companion says disappeared on a mission a year prior to that (4009 BBY). If you start at 4,000 and count back the number of years (2, then 6, then 1) you arrive at 4,009 BBY, which has to be the year of Jev's death, given that he appeared to Andur in ghost form a year later (4008 BBY).</ref>
